title: Hired Guns · Master Mechanics Register

baseline.label: OCS patched source 39.26 · explicit development-editor adaptation
baseline.description: Primary behavioural reference is the older OCS patched source, with exact local OCS roster/items. Editor maps are individually digest-pinned; no retail authentication, whole-startup, runtime-map or wall-clock parity is implied. CD32 differences stay explicit.

scope: Initial game-wide traceability register. Discovery inventory is broad but not certified exhaustive; unclassified item, enemy and source branches remain explicit work. Training43 is first original-level acceptance target.
limitations: Accepted main through PR112 food/repair, PR113 register, and PR114 bounded interaction CASE. New keyboard wet consumer is UNREVIEWED; no level, hardware or T43-05 acceptance is inferred.
Covered means the row’s stated slice is covered, not that every original branch or interaction is proven. Read mapping scope and gaps.
A linked test is a traceable test file, not a fresh passing run. Original-dependent tests may skip without local resources; public CI uses synthetic data.
Static editor observations do not prove runtime activation, target validity, reachability, required puzzle roles or completed gameplay.
Zero complete original levels are accepted. No whole-game completion percentage is calculated.
Original archives, assembly, maps, routes and raw traces remain local/ignored. This page contains summaries and links, not original content.

acceptanceChecks.title: Classify every reachable interaction

acceptanceChecks.title: Wet stairs and environmental outcomes
